method: Successful baseline Actions step intervals and Surefire XML from all 64 canonical artifacts. Case digest is SHA-256 of json.dumps(sorted((classname, name, skipped, multiplicity))) using all testcase elements per Flink/JDK cohort. Selection inventories include two abstract bases without reports; class outcomes cover the 118 reported suites. The complete selected inventory contains 120 classes. Runner time adds parallel jobs; start delays include prerequisites and queues. Candidate qualification and net performance comparison are pending.

collector_probe.limits: Five-case Flink 2.2 probe, separate preparation for each collector, three alternating pairs, current first-tier compilation and code-cache limits. Serial GC improves elapsed median by 9.0% on JDK 11 and regresses by 0.8% on JDK 17. No change to merge-gate collector defaults; broader JDK 11 qualification is pending.

extended_setup_failure.reason: Direct Surefire invocation cannot resolve the uninstalled streamfusion-json-flink1.18 reactor dependency. Normal precompiled test lifecycle and a single-line dispatch repair setup without repeating the running 2.2 probe.

native_cache_layout_baseline.observation: The native producer and upstream preparation considered the same Rust version and environment variables except upstream omitted RUST_BACKTRACE. The upstream entries have identical keys but distinct versions because their cache paths differ by Flink line. Proposed shared-key, environment and target-path normalization reuses the ordinary producer cache; source Cargo builds and exact-commit library staging remain required. Hosted verification pending.

shared_java_candidate.limits: Start delay includes prerequisites, concurrency limits and runner queues. Runner seconds exclude jobs without a completed execution interval; they are not billed minutes. Step times overlap between parallel jobs.
shared_java_candidate.interpretation: Complete canonical coverage matches the baseline. Initial compile/pack time falls to 517 seconds, with 819 seconds for consumer extraction, but total CI runner time rises 1.3% and elapsed time rises 9.0%. JDK11 canonical class execution is higher; concurrent diagnostics, cold setup and runner variation prevent an isolated causal timing claim. No whole-CI speedup is established by compilation reuse alone.

collector_worker_mix.method: Eight complete classes and 64 invocations per phase on JDK11. Independent G1/Serial metadata preparation followed by two alternating pairs on each line, four fresh 1GiB parents, unchanged 1GiB isolated child workers, C1 and 512MiB code cache. Full native work and handoff assertions retained; profiler rejects changed invocation identities. All 768 invocations pass without skips.
collector_worker_mix.decision: Use Serial GC only in JDK11 canonical test JVMs. JDK17 and shared compiler preparation keep their existing settings. Combined exact-head CI and upstream gates remain required.

native_cache_layout_candidate.scope: Both preparations restore the exact debug-jvm key from the default branch and rebuild current workspace libraries, staging Cargo-reported artifacts. Native phase timing starts at the build announcement and ends at Java-build announcement, excluding the approximately 33-second cache restore. Reference is the cold upstream run 43149562563. This intentionally measures cold versus primed cache reuse, not a same-state CPU comparison or whole-suite latency improvement.

handoff_poll_probe.method: One metadata preparation and three alternating one-second/100ms pairs, same five Flink2.2 handoff cases on each JDK; same conditions and deadlines. All 70 invocations pass.
handoff_poll_probe.decision: Keep the one-second wait. The JDK11 median improvement is 1.3%, JDK17 regresses 1.5%, and CPU rises slightly on both. No polling property or interval change ships. Retain shallow native-source verification from the successful diagnostic.
